from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InterestExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of interest expense extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    interest_expense_amount: float = Field(description="The specific interest expense amount reported as a numeric value")
    currency: str = Field(description="The currency unit of the reported amount (e.g., CNY, USD, 元)")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period or quarter this data covers (e.g., 2024 Q1)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the label and amount for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    interest_expense_records: list[InterestExpenseRecord]
